skill.name: linkedin-optimization
skill.description: Use when optimizing a LinkedIn profile so recruiters can find you in search and so the headline and about section convert views into messages.
whenToUse: Rewriting a LinkedIn headline to be keyword-rich and value-focused
Improving recruiter discoverability through keywords and a complete profile
Crafting an About section that reads as a story, not a list of duties
Auditing a profile for the gaps that hurt search ranking and trust

keyConcepts.explanation: The headline is your most-seen field and is searchable. Combine your role with a value proposition and key skills (e.g., role + specialty + outcome) rather than only your current title.
Recruiters filter by keywords across headline, About, skills, and experience. Placing the terms they search for, in natural language, raises how often you appear in results.
The About summary should open with a hook, convey what you do and the value you deliver, and weave in keywords. First-person and specific beats a generic third-person bio.
A complete profile (photo, headline, experience, skills, education) ranks and converts better. LinkedIn favors fuller profiles, and recruiters trust them more.
Listed skills are searchable filters and feed the algorithm. Pin the most relevant skills to your target role and gather endorsements/recommendations for credibility.
A clean custom public URL looks professional on resumes, and setting profile visibility / Open to Work appropriately controls who can find and approach you.

apiReference.purpose: Pull the recurring titles, skills, and tools from roles you want, to use across your profile.
apiReference.example: Scan 5 target job posts; list the 10 most repeated keywords

apiReference.purpose: Combine role, specialty, and value/outcome with searchable keywords within the character limit.
apiReference.example: 'Data Analyst | SQL & Python | turning messy data into revenue decisions'

apiReference.purpose: Open with a hook, state what you do and the impact, and embed keywords naturally over a few short paragraphs.
apiReference.example: Para 1: hook + what you do. Para 2: proof/metrics. Para 3: what you're seeking + call to action.

apiReference.purpose: Use achievement bullets in roles, pin top relevant skills, and add a quality photo and banner.
apiReference.example: Pin top 3 skills to your goal role; add metrics to each recent role's bullets

apiReference.purpose: Claim a custom public URL, review visibility settings, and enable recruiter-facing signals if job hunting.
apiReference.example: Set linkedin.com/in/yourname; enable 'Open to Work' (recruiters-only if discreet)

gotchas: Leaving the headline as just your job title wastes your most-searched and most-seen field
Keyword stuffing reads as spam to humans; weave terms into natural sentences instead
A missing or low-quality photo sharply reduces profile views and trust
An empty About section is a major gap; recruiters often skim it right after the headline
Generic third-person bios feel templated — write in first person with specifics and numbers
Forgetting to set the custom public URL leaves an ugly numeric link on your resume and emails
If using 'Open to Work', choose recruiters-only visibility if you don't want your employer to see it
